effects.printed_clause: Main Phase while controlling Wicked Puppeteer Orchis: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon this from hand/GY. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Main-Phase Quick Effect checks either true/current Orchis code, Tributes another controlled monster with zone accounting, then summons the handler from hand/GY; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Tributes a controlled monster as cost and Special Summons the effect's handler from a nonstandard location.

effects.printed_clause: If Summoned while controlling a Ritual Monster: target and destroy opponent card. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal, Flip and Special Summon trigger clones share HOPT and target/destroy an opponent on-field card when a face-up Ritual is controlled.

official_references.matched_structure: Targets and destroys an opponent Spell/Trap/on-field card with relation checks.

coverage_override.reason: The Main-Phase self-Summon procedure and the on-Summon destruction trigger are the two distinct effects; the shared 'each effect' HOPT sentence is represented in both records.
